hunt.justification: The exploitation of CVE-2026-90436 provides an immediate foothold that leads to identity theft and high-value data exfiltration. Because attackers are known to pivot from application servers to cloud resources using service accounts, a negative result across both endpoint and cloud surfaces is required to confirm that the intrusion has not progressed to the data exfiltration stage.

meta.analysis: A static detection rule might catch 'GetNPUsers.py', but this hunt uses stack-counting to identify rare enumeration scripts on vulnerable servers and then pivots into cloud API activity to correlate that activity with sensitive data access. This context allows an analyst to distinguish between a developer testing a script and an active intruder exfiltrating data.

scenario.summary: Attackers exploit a critical unauthenticated RCE in Apache Axis (CVE-2026-90436) affecting Atlassian Confluence and N-able N-central to gain initial footprints. Using AI-assisted automation, they harvest credentials from local databases and file attachments before pivoting to internal identity services and production cloud environments.

meta.rationale: Begin by identifying all hosts specifically detected as vulnerable to CVE-2026-90436. Focus the hunt on these hosts and any service accounts they use for database or cloud integration.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has pivoted from a compromised application server to internal identity services for AS-REP roasting and accessed cloud data warehouses using stolen service account credentials.

blind_spots.risk: While we see the API calls, the exact content of the queries or the rows returned might not be visible if the provider does not supply detailed payload logs to the management plane.
blind_spots.question: Which specific data records were exfiltrated from the warehouse?
blind_spots.requires: Audit logging for specific data warehouse providers (Snowflake/BigQuery) integrated with hb_cloud_api_activity
blind_spots.remediation: Enable high-verbosity audit logging for all production data warehouses and stream to the central log repository.

blind_spots.risk: If the attacker renames 'GetNPUsers.py' to a legitimate script name, the baseline step relies solely on command-line pattern matching, which can be bypassed if the script is run through a custom interpreter.
blind_spots.question: Did the attacker rename the Impacket tools to bypass name-based detection?
blind_spots.remediation: Enable file hash auditing for all Python script executions on application servers.

hunt.name: Identity Pivot and Cloud Resource Access following Axis RCE
hunt.description: After gaining an initial foothold on Atlassian Confluence or N-able N-central servers, attackers are known to perform identity service enumeration using Impacket and then access cloud data warehouses using acquired integration credentials. This hunt identifies these pivots by finding rare enumeration tools on vulnerable hosts and corroborating them with anomalous cloud API calls and sign-ins from known attacker infrastructure. An agent weighs the endpoint and cloud telemetry together to determine if an intrusion has progressed to the data exfiltration stage.

nodes.label: Identify vulnerable Confluence and N-central hosts

config.content: SELECT device_uid, title, severity, first_seen FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE cve_uid = 'CVE-2026-90436' OR title LIKE '%Axis 1.x%'
config.description: Identify hosts where the specific vulnerability CVE-2026-90436 has been detected to focus the investigation on the most likely targets.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts specifically flagged with CVE-2026-90436. Zero rows means no scanner has identified the vulnerability yet.

primitive_config.label: Identify vulnerable Confluence and N-central hosts
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_uid, title, severity, first_seen FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE cve_uid = 'CVE-2026-90436' OR title LIKE '%Axis 1.x%'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts specifically flagged with CVE-2026-90436. Zero rows means no scanner has identified the vulnerability yet.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_name) AS proc, process_cmd_line, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{impacket_strings}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_cmd_line) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%impacket%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%getnpusers%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY proc, process_cmd_line HAVING hosts < 5 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Identify the use of Impacket or other identity enumeration tools; the actor uses these to find targets for lateral movement.
config.expected_signal: Rare command lines containing Impacket script names, particularly when running under a Python interpreter on the application servers.

primitive_config.label: Rare identity enumeration tools

config.content: SELECT time, actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, api_operation, api_service_name, resource_name FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{attacker_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%integration%' OR LOWER(actor_user_name) LIKE '%service%') AND (LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%select%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%export%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%getobject%' OR LOWER(api_operation) LIKE '%copyobject%') AND (LOWER(api_service_name) LIKE '%snowflake%' OR LOWER(api_service_name) LIKE '%bigquery%' OR LOWER(api_service_name) LIKE '%s3%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Filter for data-access and exfiltration-related calls to cloud warehouses originating from attacker infrastructure or service accounts.
config.expected_signal: Data access operations targeting cloud warehouses from reported attacker IPs or integration accounts that do not typically use these operations from the internet.
